title: Tethered in Smoke and Sin
trope_profile: Fake Captive / Morally Gray Shadow Warlord

protagonist.name: Elena Vance
protagonist.appearance: Dark auburn waves, hazel-amber eyes with flecks of gold, athletic frame, sharp cheekbones, expressive lips.
protagonist.personality: Witty, fiercely resilient, observant, guarded, refuses to bow to tyrants, passionate under pressure.
protagonist.magic: Latent Celestial Dawn-Fire (dormant mortal sun-resonance that counters and heals shadow corruption).

male_lead.name: Lord Vaelen Thorne
male_lead.title: High Commander of the Umbral Guard, Lord of the Nightglass Citadel
male_lead.appearance: 6'4", broad-shouldered, lean lethal muscle, silver molten eyes, raven hair swept back, angular jaw, throat and chest inked in glowing violet-shadow runes.
male_lead.personality: Brooding, lethally dangerous, tactical genius, outwardly cold and merciless, fiercely protective of Elena, sensual, possessive.
male_lead.magic: Master of Umbral Shifting (shadow tendrils, spatial phasing, blade resonance, nocturnal sensory vision).

antagonist.name: High King Malakor
antagonist.title: Sovereign of the Black Sun
antagonist.description: Cruel, decadent, obsessed with bleeding mortal lifeforce to maintain his decaying immortality.

supporting.name: Kaelen
supporting.role: Vaelen's loyal second-in-command, dual-dagger scout with dry humor.

supporting.name: Lady Lysandra
supporting.role: Spymistress of the Silk Court, politically treacherous, former suitor of Vaelen.

setting.world: The Realm of Aethelgard (The Obsidian Veil)
setting.atmosphere: Perpetual twilight, silver mist, black obsidian spires, luminescent violet flora, cold mountain winds, opulent gothic palaces lit by bioluminescent glass lanterns.
rules_of_the_tether: Cannot separate beyond 50 paces without burning spiritual pain.
Sensory bleed: Heartbeats sync; extreme emotions (rage, lust, fear) echo across the link.
Shared lifeforce: Severe injury to one physically shocks the other; fatal blow to one kills both unless broken.

chapters.title: The Glass Relic
chapters.focus: Elena in Chicago archives, the cracked mirror, the pull across worlds.

chapters.title: The Blade and the Beast
chapters.focus: Crashing onto the obsidian throne, meeting Vaelen, the blade at her throat, the tether ignites.

chapters.title: A Chain of Smoke
chapters.focus: The agony of separation, escorted to Vaelen's private tower, establishing boundary rules.

chapters.title: The Bath of Ash and Silk
chapters.focus: Washing the grime of travel, Vaelen walks in, breathless forced proximity, sensory bleed.

chapters.title: The Court of Raven Mirrors
chapters.focus: Audience before King Malakor, Vaelen claims her as his favored captive, poisoned wine thwarted.

chapters.title: Whispers in the Dark
chapters.focus: Unlacing her gown, first electric touch, secrets of the lost mortals, building sexual tension.

chapters.title: The Midnight Ambush
chapters.focus: Shadow assassins attack Vaelen's tower, fighting back-to-back, Elena saves his life with hidden blade.

chapters.title: Into the Twilight Fen
chapters.focus: Fleeing the capital on war-beasts, branded as traitors, entering the wild untamed fens.

chapters.title: The Runed Sanctuary
chapters.focus: Taking shelter in ancient ruins, cleaning Vaelen's wounds, vulnerability beneath the armor.

chapters.title: The Heat of the Hearth
chapters.focus: Rainstorm outside, sharing a single fur bedroll, mutual confessions, explosive first kiss.

chapters.title: The Awakening
chapters.focus: Elena's celestial dawn-fire sparks, Vaelen trains her hands, skin-to-skin magical grounding.

chapters.title: Smoke and Skin
chapters.focus: The dam breaks: full scorching steamy encounter by firelight, breathless passion and intimacy.

chapters.title: The River of Souls
chapters.focus: Crossing the Mist-Fens, meeting the Nightglass Oracle, prophecy of the Eclipse Bond.

chapters.title: Treachery at Iron Keep
chapters.focus: Reaching a supposed allied stronghold, betrayal from within, Elena captured and dragged into the deep cells.

chapters.title: Severance
chapters.focus: The agony of magical distance, Elena fighting back, Vaelen going full demonic warlord to find her.

chapters.title: Reunion in Blood
chapters.focus: Vaelen breaches the dungeons, desperate possessive reunion against the stone wall, renewed bond.

chapters.title: Forging the Eclipse Blade
chapters.focus: Merging celestial fire with umbral steel, preparing for the counter-coup.

chapters.title: Eve of the Blood Moon
chapters.focus: Quiet intimacy before war, pledging souls to each other, emotional and physical devotion.

chapters.title: Infiltration of the Spire
chapters.focus: Breaching the Obsidian Palace under cover of night, stealth and lethal teamwork.

chapters.title: The Clash of Kings
chapters.focus: Vaelen vs. King Malakor in the grand throne room, Elena unleashes full dawn-fire storm.

chapters.title: Breaking the Mirror
chapters.focus: Shattering the dark dimensional anchor, Elena's choice: stay in Aethelgard with Vaelen forever.

chapters.title: Crowning the Shadow King
chapters.focus: Vaelen claims the throne, proclaims Elena his equal Queen before the kneeling lords.

chapters.title: Coronation Night
chapters.focus: Opulent celebratory feast, royal chambers, decadent euphoric intimacy in silk and velvet.

chapters.title: Tethered in Eternity
chapters.focus: Epilogue: Ruling the healed realm, dawn rising over the Obsidian Veil, forever bound.
